claims_source: followthroughhealth.com home page and DocBridge page as of 2026-10-23: 'explains every result in plain words', 'shows which ones to ask about first', 'gets you ready for the doctor', 'one-page doctor brief', 'Free, and read on your own device', 'English and Español', DocBridge 'draft, a named clinician edits and approves, then the patient gets a private link', doctor pilot waitlist.

campaigns.title: Mom's Lab Report
campaigns.audience: Adult children looking after a parent
campaigns.voice: Adult narrator, 30s to 50s, warm and unhurried, like a friend who has been through it. No announcer energy. Spanish: neutral Latin American, same warmth.
campaigns.visuals: Actor as adult daughter at a kitchen table at night, phone in hand. Screen recordings of the real app with a synthetic sample report only. No real patient data, no real doctor.
campaigns.music: Soft solo piano or acoustic guitar, slow (about 70 BPM), no lyrics. Starts after the first line, lifts gently on the brand line.
on_screen: Not medical advice. Always talk to your doctor.

en: Mom's lab report came in at nine at night.
Pages of numbers. Short forms. Ranges written for doctors.
FollowThrough Health explains every result in plain words.
It shows which results to ask about first.
And it gets you ready for the doctor, with a one-page brief.
In English or Spanish. Free, and read on your own device.
FollowThrough Health. Ready for the visit.
es: El análisis de mamá llegó ya de noche.
Páginas de números. Siglas. Rangos escritos para médicos.
FollowThrough Health explica cada resultado en palabras sencillas.
Le muestra qué resultados preguntar primero.
Y le ayuda a prepararse para el médico, con un resumen de una página.
En español o inglés. Gratis, y en su propio dispositivo.
FollowThrough Health. Listos para la consulta.

campaigns.title: What Does This Mean?
campaigns.audience: Anyone who has opened a lab report and got stuck on the short forms
campaigns.style: Educational: clear, friendly, confident without overstating accuracy
campaigns.voice: Friendly, clear narrator. Slightly brisker than the family ad but every word easy to catch. Spanish: neutral Latin American.
campaigns.visuals: Lab short forms pop on screen one by one from a synthetic report, then the app's plain-word line for each. No values that suggest a disease.
campaigns.music: Light, curious pizzicato or marimba, about 95 BPM, low under the voice.
on_screen: Explains reports. Does not diagnose. Talk to your doctor.

en: eGFR. A1C. TSH. What does this mean?
Lab reports are written for clinicians. You still have to read them.
FollowThrough Health explains every result in plain words.
Each one is checked against the range printed on your own report.
Then it writes questions to bring to your doctor.
It explains. It doesn't diagnose. Your doctor does that.
FollowThrough Health. Free to try.
es: TFGe. A1C. TSH. ¿Qué significa esto?
Los análisis se escriben para médicos. Pero usted tiene que leerlos.
FollowThrough Health explica cada resultado en palabras sencillas.
Cada uno se compara con el rango impreso en su propio informe.
Y escribe preguntas para llevar a su médico.
Explica. No diagnostica. Eso lo hace su médico.
FollowThrough Health. Pruébelo gratis.

en: eGFR. A1C. TSH. What does this mean?

Then ask your doctor.
FollowThrough Health.

campaigns.title: Three Simple Steps
campaigns.audience: Families ready to try the app
campaigns.style: Educational: clear, friendly, step by step
campaigns.voice: Calm, friendly guide. Short pause after each number. Spanish: neutral Latin American.
campaigns.visuals: Real app screen recording with a synthetic sample report: choose a report, read the explanations, open the doctor questions and brief.
campaigns.music: Simple upbeat acoustic, about 100 BPM, ducked under each step.
on_screen: Not medical advice. Always talk to your doctor.

en: Three simple steps.
One. Add the report. A PDF, a photo, or type the numbers.
Two. Read every result in plain words, with the ones to ask about first.
Three. Take your questions and a one-page brief to the doctor.
In English or Spanish. Free, and read on your own device.
FollowThrough Health.
es: Tres pasos sencillos.
Uno. Agregue el informe. Un PDF, una foto, o escriba los números.
Dos. Lea cada resultado en palabras sencillas, con los que debe preguntar primero.
Tres. Lleve sus preguntas y un resumen de una página al médico.
En español o en inglés. Gratis, y se lee en su propio dispositivo.
FollowThrough Health.

campaigns.title: DocBridge
campaigns.voice: Calm, professional narrator, measured pace. No hype words. Spanish: neutral Latin American, formal usted.
campaigns.visuals: DocBridge demo mode with the made-up demo clinic and synthetic patient: draft, edit, approve, private link. No real clinician, logo or endorsement.
campaigns.music: Minimal ambient pad, about 80 BPM, very low.
on_screen: Demo with synthetic data. Not a real clinic or patient.
Clinician-reviewed explanations. DocBridge does not diagnose.

en: Lab results often reach patients before anyone explains them.
DocBridge drafts a plain-language explanation of each result.
A named clinician edits it, and approves it.
Then the patient gets a private link.
The patient sees it only after it is approved.
DocBridge, from FollowThrough Health. Join the pilot waitlist.
es: Los resultados suelen llegar al paciente antes de que alguien los explique.
DocBridge prepara un borrador en lenguaje sencillo de cada resultado.
Un profesional clínico lo revisa, lo edita y lo aprueba.
Después, el paciente recibe un enlace privado.
El paciente lo ve solo después de la aprobación.
DocBridge, de FollowThrough Health. Únase a la lista del piloto.
